codeReview.summary: The feature removes empty catch syntax and covers the priority files, but several replacements only add comments and still discard failures silently, which does not satisfy the requirement to log, emit telemetry, or propagate errors.

issues.description: This formerly-empty catch now contains only a comment and still swallows selector-matching failures without logging, telemetry, or propagation. The feature description and VAL-CRIT-004 require empty catches to be handled, not merely annotated. The same pattern also appears at lines 185 and 224 in this file.

The injected typing path replaces empty catches with comment-only blocks, so scrollIntoView failures are still silently ignored rather than logged or otherwise handled. This does not meet the requirement to add console.warn, telemetry, or error propagation; the same issue repeats at line 142.

The OAuth model catalog refresh catch block remains comment-only after the change. If provider model discovery fails, the failure is still silently discarded with no warning or telemetry, which does not meet the feature’s required error-handling behavior. Similar comment-only replacements were introduced in other modified files such as packages/extension/sidepanel/ui/status/model-catalog-fetch.ts:126, packages/extension/sidepanel/ui/status/model-profile-editor.ts:133, packages/extension/background/session-lifecycle.ts:25, and packages/extension/tools/browser-click-tools.ts:92.
